question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Splendid
solution:
The correct answer is **"Spectacular."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Splendid"** means very good; excellent. (बहुत अच्‍छा; अत्‍युत्तम)

 
 
• **Example**: *What a **splendid**__ idea!*
 
 
 
• **"Spectacular"** means impressive or sensational. ((देखने में) बहुत शानदार और भव्‍य)
 __
 
• **Example**:* The fireworks display was absolutely **spectacular**__.*
 
 
 
• **Splendid and Spectacular** both refer to something that is very impressive or beautiful.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Stationary):** This refers to something that is not moving, like a stationary bike or a stationary object. (खड़ा हुआ; स्थिर, गतिहीन)
 
• **Option 2 (Authentic):** This refers to something that is genuine or real, like authentic Italian food or an authentic piece of art. (प्रामाणिक, असली)
 
• **Option 4 (Enticing):** This refers to something that is tempting or attractive, like an enticing offer or an enticing aroma. (लुभाने वाला, सम्‍मोहक)
